pins.title: How to Actually Disconnect on a Weekend Away
pins.description: A waterfront host's field guide to actually disconnecting. Two phone windows a day, one real meal cooked, and a tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck setting the schedule instead of you.
pins.altText: A sunset over the dock rail on a quiet Northern Neck creek.

pins.title: The Slow Weekend: An Unplugged Trip That Works
pins.description: The slow weekend is a skill, not a setting. What actually works on an unplugged trip: friction on purpose, no itinerary, and a creek that changes character through the day.
pins.altText: Rose light over the water at the end of a private dock, Virginia's Northern Neck.

pins.title: Digital Detox Weekend: A Waterfront Field Guide
pins.description: A digital detox weekend that survives contact with reality. Phone face-down on the counter, the dock instead of the feed, on a quiet creek 2 hours 45 minutes from Washington DC.
pins.altText: A screened porch and creek view at Captain's Cottage on Virginia's Northern Neck.
